name: stefano-wiki
description: Codebase Wiki LLM: an evidence-backed project wiki maintained by coding agents.

plugins.name: codebase-wiki-llm
plugins.description: Maintain a living, LLM-owned wiki of a codebase (wiki/ by default, or a folder you choose such as .wiki/). Adds /wiki-init, /wiki-ingest, /wiki-sync, /wiki-lint, and a wiki context skill.
